suggestions.topic: EIP-8365 0x00 deposit handling: burn vs re-queue decision
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDC #190 with explicit two-week revisit (matching this call). Choice between burning ETH from post-fork 0x00 deposits versus Barnabas' proposal to re-queue balance as 0x01 deposits. Teams were asked to discuss at Devcon.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam bid gossip specification: PR5774 vs PR5776
suggestions.rationale: Two competing approaches with fundamental disagreement (Potuz prefers no gossip filtering vs Nico's 3% increment + DOS protection). Teams were asked to review within a few days of Oct 29; needs resolution before Glamsterdam mainnet.

suggestions.topic: FOCIL payload rebuild ambiguity and EL team input
suggestions.rationale: Critical Engine API clarification: some ELs rebuild entire payload on inclusion list update at 6s causing missed blocks; CL expects append-only. Barnabas was to bring this to next ACDE for EL input. Blocking for FOCIL devnet stability.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam devnet status and Lido PR testing
suggestions.rationale: Devnet with Lido's consensus-breaking PR was estimated for Nov 16-20 launch (post-Oct 30 spec release). Status update needed on whether devnet is live, any issues discovered, and readiness for mainnet Glamsterdam.

suggestions.topic: Hegota headliner decision and devnet planning
suggestions.rationale: ACDC #190 proposed sequencing (FOCIL + frames first, smaller EIPs next, quick slots in parallel). Multiple EIPs now CFI'd (8015 SFI'd, 8334, 8383, 8148, 8411). Need to confirm scope, select headliners, and plan first devnet timeline.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8198 quick slots validation for 12→10s reduction
suggestions.rationale: CFI'd in ACDC #188 with explicit caveat that 12→10s reduction requires further validation before SFI. PQ/testing concerns were raised by multiple teams. Need status update on validation work and path to SFI.

ACDC #190 established requirement that PQ deposit contract must address deposit front-running (following EIP-8205 DFI). Informational update on whether PQ design work has incorporated this constraint.
Ben Edgington takes over as lead ACDC moderator (with Will Corcoran as deputy) starting this call, following Alex Stokes' departure. Brief acknowledgment and any procedural changes.
